name: docs
description: Turn a project into evidence-tagged Markdown knowledge. doc-mine interviews you first (what you know, what you want, what you assume but never checked), then mines the source into categorized docs/ where every sentence cites file:line, an official URL, or an actual run — gaps are marked [UNVERIFIED] instead of guessed. doc-distill condenses it all into one self-contained file you can hand to anyone. Cross-platform, zero-dependency.
